description: This file defines the class GeoZone which manages geo zone entities in an OpenCart admin module. It includes methods for creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving geo zone data, as well as managing associated zones and caching.

classes.name: GeoZone
classes.description: Handles CRUD operations and retrieval for geo zones and associated zones in the OpenCart admin module.

methods.name: addGeoZone
methods.description: Creates a new geo zone record in the database, optionally adding zone-to-geo-zone associations.

methods.name: editGeoZone
methods.description: Updates an existing geo zone record and its associated zones.

methods.name: deleteGeoZone
methods.description: Removes a geo zone record and its related zones from the database.

methods.name: getGeoZone
methods.description: Retrieves a specific geo zone record by its ID.

methods.name: getGeoZones
methods.description: Retrieves a list of geo zone records based on filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalGeoZones
methods.description: Returns the total count of geo zones.

methods.name: addZone
methods.description: Adds a zone to a specific geo zone.

methods.name: deleteZones
methods.description: Deletes all zone-to-geo-zone relationships for a specific geo zone.

methods.name: getZones
methods.description: Retrieves zone-to-geo-zone records for a specific geo zone.

methods.name: getZonesByCountryId
methods.description: Retrieves zone-to-geo-zone records for a specific country.

methods.name: getTotalZones
methods.description: Returns the total number of zone-to-geo-zone records for a given geo zone.

methods.name: getTotalZoneToGeoZoneByCountryId
methods.description: Counts zone-to-geo-zone records for a specific country.

methods.name: getTotalZoneToGeoZoneByZoneId
methods.description: Counts zone-to-geo-zone records for a specific zone.
